note: A carried key (an auxiliary table's join key) rides along with its table's whole edition and serves no cell, so it takes no member, window or data_warning; and it rides along only in a file of its table's own variant, so the table must serve some cell of that variant.
fails_if: a carried mapping with a window is admitted (the compiled holding_key has no window, so the key would silently ride along over the whole edition), or a table carrying a key of a variant it serves no cell of is admitted (no file of it is ever ordered, so the key never rides along and nothing says so)

message_contains: carried key scb/example/annual scb/example/id takes no member, window or data_warning
table['Dead']: Value error, carries a key of scb/example/annual but serves no cell of it
